description: Implementation of the Framebuffer9 class for Direct3D 9 rendering in ANGLE, including methods for discard, invalidate, clear, readPixels, blit, and state synchronization.

classes.name: Framebuffer9
classes.description: A class implementing framebuffer operations for Direct3D 9 in ANGLE, including methods for discard, invalidate, clear, readPixels, blit, and state synchronization.

methods.name: clearImpl
methods.description: Performs clearing of the framebuffer, setting viewport, scissor, and invoking renderer clear.

methods.name: readPixelsImpl
methods.description: Reads pixel data from the framebuffer, handling multisampling, surface locking, and pixel packing.

methods.name: blitImpl
methods.description: Performs blitting (copying) between framebuffers, including color and depth/stencil buffers, with rectangle clipping.
